Native WidgetEventFeed mirrors the web shared component + its TimelineItem rows: formatRelativeTime ('Just now' / '{n}m ago' / '{n}h ago' (<24h) / formatDateTime) and inline formatDateTime (toLocaleString month/day/hour/minute, nullish -> em-dash) ported faithfully; limit = maxItems ?? (compact?3:10); sorted = [...items].sort(timestamp desc).slice(0,limit) via useMemo; empty -> <EmptyState> with t('widget.noEvents','No events yet') default; each row = colour-tinted 32x32 rounded icon dot (bg `${color}15`) + vertical connector (hidden on last) + title (truncate) / optional subtitle / relative time, matching the web TimelineItem visual intent.

Browser-only / unported deps reduced and documented inline: react-i18next useTranslation->useNativeTranslation; lucide icons->emoji glyphs; WidgetShell->native shell reproducing the loading skeleton, error body, the 1500ms green pulse-on-update effect, and an inline DataFreshness chip (fresh/fetching/stale/error glyph+relative time, tap-to-refresh, dot-only compact when title-less); ./shared WidgetEventFeed/EventFeedItem->native feed; ./types WidgetProps->local interfaces. No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported — imports limited to react, react-native (Pressable/StyleSheet/View), @tanstack/react-query useQuery, the native AppText + theme tokens, and the already-ported web-parity useVehicles hook / request client / SecurityEvent type.

Tailwind/DOM -> React Native: div/h3/p -> View/AppText; flex/gap -> flexDirection+columnGap/rowGap+gap; h-8 w-8 rounded-lg -> 32x32 borderRadius 8; w-px flex-1 bg-[var(--surface-2)] -> width 1 flex-1 colors.border connector; text-sm/text-xs/text-[10px] -> 14/12/10; text-[var(--text-primary|muted)] -> colors.textPrimary/textMuted; text-gray-600 -> #4b5563; text-neon-cyan -> colors.accent; the inner overflow-y-auto list is reduced to a bounded static column because rows are already hard-capped by maxItems via .slice() and native dashboard tiles scroll within the screen container (avoids nested-scroll anti-pattern). Styles alphabetised (keys + properties) per react-native/sort-styles. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
